settings.editor: An Arabic apps and games studio

settings.title: We make what delights and benefits

settings.editor: Farhoon is an Arabic studio making apps and games for Arab families: clear Arabic, cheerful design, and full respect for your privacy.
That every Arab home finds on its phone what benefits and delights it, in its own language, without paying for it with its privacy.

settings.description_text: Clear Modern Standard Arabic every Arab understands, designed right-to-left from the first step.
Everything we make has real value and a cheerful design that brings joy.
We collect as little as possible, and what you enter stays on your phone wherever we can.
Easy screens for young and old, with clear text and few steps.

settings.editor: Your daily companion for Quran, prayer and dhikr. A complete Islamic app, a lasting charity, with more than twenty sections.
FreeNo adsNo accountData stays on your phone

settings.title: Islamic apps for kids we are building

settings.editor: We are designing apps that teach children their faith through play: lovable characters, motion and sound, games and rewards that bring them back every day, and that parents can trust.
